guidanceAndCall.item: Food delivery adjusted EBITDA steady state 5-6% of NOV; Q1FY27 at 5.6% "approaching the upper end"

Blinkit steady state: capex ₹2.5 cr/store incl. warehousing (was ₹1 cr), NWC 12 days of NOV (3.3%), ₹11 lakh NOV/store/day, 6% adjusted EBITDA, 4% EBIT (after ESOP and depreciation), pre-tax ROCE 41.7%
Blinkit NOV growth "north of 60%" a year over three years (Q4FY26 letter)
Going-out target: US$3bn NOV by FY30; 60% YoY growth in Q1FY27 "not a seasonality artifact"
Q1FY27 was the peak of competitive intensity so far; competitors subsidise grocery and delivery fees; NAOV expected to stay in the same range
Capex per store over 6-9 months lower than ₹2.5 cr; warehousing capex is lumpy
Inventory losses ~1.8% of NOV, inside COGS; all employee and tech costs expensed
Tax: parent carried-forward losses fully used in FY27; subsidiaries (QC, B2B, going-out) still carry losses

history.event: Founded as Foodiebay by Deepinder Goyal and Pankaj Chaddah; renamed Zomato in 2010 (company incorporated 2010, CIN L93030DL2010PLC198141)
Acquired Uber Eats India in an all-stock deal; Uber received about 9.99% of Zomato (reported deal value ~$350m; one source says $206m)
IPO at Rs 72-76 (priced at Rs 76), Rs 9,375 cr (Rs 9,000 cr fresh plus Rs 375 cr OFS by Info Edge), subscribed ~38x
Listed on NSE/BSE, opening at Rs 116 (+53%)
Board approved acquiring Blink Commerce (Blinkit): 33,018 shares for ~Rs 4,447 cr, paid in up to 62,85,30,012 new Zomato shares at ~Rs 70.76
Blinkit acquisition closed; consolidated from 10-Aug-2022
SoftBank (SVF Growth Singapore) sold 10 cr shares (1.16%) on NSE after its lock-in ended; a later sale of 1.09% for Rs 1,040 cr cut its holding to 1.08% (date not confirmed)
Alipay (Alibaba affiliate) exited its remaining stake at Rs 112.7/share (reported in a secondary source)
Agreed to buy Paytm's (One 97) entertainment ticketing business (OTPL: TicketNew/movies; WEPL: Insider/events) for Rs 2,048 cr in cash
Paytm ticketing acquisition completed: secondary purchase from One 97 of Rs 758 cr plus primary infusion into OTPL/WEPL of Rs 1,260 cr
District app launched for going-out (dining, movies, events)
history.impact: Going-out moved off the Zomato app over the following quarters (~1/3 of going-out GOV on District by Q4FY25)

history.event: QIP of Rs 8,500 cr: 33,64,73,755 shares at Rs 252.62 (floor Rs 265.91, 5% discount). Opened 25-Nov, closed 28-Nov, allotted 29-Nov-2024
43,75,82,009 shares plus 3,99,52,836 bonus shares (total 47.75 cr) allotted to the Foodie Bay Employees ESOP Trust for future ESOP issuance
Included in the BSE Sensex, replacing JSW Steel (first new-age tech company in the index)
Bistro (10-minute food delivery, Blinkit-owned kitchens) launched; part of 'Others' from Q3FY25
Board approved renaming Zomato Ltd to Eternal Ltd; shareholders approved by special resolution in early Mar-2025
MCA approved the name change to Eternal Ltd (effective 20-Mar-2025); ticker changed from ZOMATO to ETERNAL (exact ticker switch date not verified)
Included in the Nifty 50, replacing BPCL/Britannia (with Jio Financial). One source gives 31-Mar
Board approved a 49.5% cap on foreign ownership to keep IOCC status; shareholders approved 19-May-2025
history.impact: Allowed Blinkit inventory (1P) ownership; FPI index-weight cuts

history.event: Q4FY25 letter: IOCC status confirmed; 'Zomato Quick' and 'Everyday' shut down
Food delivery COO Rinshul Chandra left (7-Apr); CEO Rakesh Ranjan replaced by Aditya Mangla (6-Jul)
Blinkit began moving from a marketplace (3P) to an inventory-led (1P) model; ~3% of NOV was on own inventory in Q1FY26. Hyperpure's non-restaurant (seller) business scaled down as a result
history.impact: QC revenue now gross of goods; NWC up; Hyperpure revenue down

history.event: Antfin Singapore (Alibaba) block deal: 14.13 cr shares at Rs 289.91 (~Rs 4,097 cr), exiting its holding
Blinkit Foods Ltd incorporated (quick food service subsidiary)
GST on local delivery through e-commerce operators (section 9(5)) took effect
history.impact: Eternal pays GST on delivery charges

history.event: Board approved the slump sale of Bistro by Blinkit to Blinkit Foods Ltd for Rs 57 cr
Block deal by an unnamed institutional seller: ~5.2-5.3 cr shares (~0.5%), floor Rs 289.50, ~Rs 1,500-1,535 cr
Labour Codes, including the Code on Social Security 2020, came into force
Deepinder Goyal announced he would step down as Group CEO; Albinder Dhindsa named successor effective 1-Feb-2026
Deepinder Goyal appointed Vice Chairman & Non-Executive Director
Large FPI-to-DII rotation: FII 36.2% to 32.6%, MF to 28.9%. Kuwait Investment Authority fully exited; Govt of Singapore cut from 1.37% to 1.11%
Zomato Media (Private) Ltd struck off
Q4FY26 results: cash Rs 17,972 cr; 2,243 Blinkit stores

Q1FY27 results: B2C NOV Rs 31,120 cr (+54%); adj EBITDA Rs 555 cr. Blinkit adj EBITDA +Rs 102 cr (0.6% of NOV); 2,443 stores. 'Others' now covers Bistro, Nugget, Greening India and Eternal General Services Foundation (Section 8 not-for-profit subsidiary). Food-delivery GOV disclosure dropped
16th AGM (via video conference)

governance.detail: Orders for Oct-2019 to Mar-2022 (all states) INR 420 cr; Order for FY23, Andhra Pradesh, INR 8 cr; SCN for FY23, Gujarat, INR 13 cr; SCN for FY24, Andhra Pradesh, INR 6 cr. These seek GST on delivery charges collected on behalf of delivery partners, plus interest and penalty. The company is contesting them, citing expert advice that it has a strong case. Total about INR 447 cr plus interest and penalty. Disclosed as a contingent liability.

From 22-Sep-2025, local delivery services supplied through e-commerce operators by unregistered providers are notified under section 9(5) CGST. Eternal now pays GST on delivery charges collected for unregistered delivery partners.
Order under section 26(1) of the Competition Act received in FY22. The investigation is ongoing and the company is cooperating.
IFAT writ petition (filed FY22) in the Supreme Court seeking recognition of gig workers as 'workers' and social-security schemes. No specific obligation is ascribed to the company yet.

Four Labour Codes, including the Code on Social Security 2020, notified effective 21-Nov-2025; draft rules released 30-Dec-2025. The company assessed no material impact from the provisions then in force.
Consumer and other legal cases INR 20 cr (Mar-25: INR 14 cr)
On 16-Oct-2025 the board approved transferring 'Bistro by Blinkit' to Blinkit Foods Ltd (a subsidiary incorporated 18-Aug-2025 and a related party) as a slump sale for INR 57 cr

Share-based payment expense INR 819 cr in FY26 (INR 798 cr FY25). About 16.2 cr options outstanding under ESOP 2021, 2022 and 2024 at Mar-26. The ESOP trust holds 45.65 cr shares (4.73%). See the esop section.

The founder (until 1-Feb-2026), the CEO (from 1-Feb-2026) and the CFO (from 1-Jan-2022) all waived salary; compensation comes through ESOPs. Independent directors received remuneration (15.42 each as printed; the unit is ambiguous in the extracted table) plus sitting fees. The nominee director is unpaid.

Up to FY26, income tax was provided only on other income (treasury). The standalone parent's carried-forward business losses will be fully used in FY27, so tax on business income began in Q1FY27. Blinkit, Hyperpure and District subsidiaries still carry losses.
The founder moved to a non-executive role and the CEO is not on the board. As a result the board has no executive director (6 directors: 4 independent and 2 non-executive).
